items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Those that I had not know except Bobby Starke were Russell Procope, Elmer Williams(alto and tenor), Jonny Hodges, alto, Cuffee Davidson, trombone...

ctx.x: One night I had nothing to do and as I had been invited by Bobby Starke to come and listen to Chick Webb's bank whenever I had the chance, I decided to do that. The dancing school was for whites only but coloured musicians could go in and sit near the bandstand to listen to Chick and talk with the fellows when they had a smoking break.

Chick was a little humpbacked fellow about 4 feet tall but that was no handicap for him when it came to playing drums and he was doing things with those drums that I had not heard another drummer do. He was taking breaks and playing the cymbals with a different beat behind each soloist. He had a real swinging group with a bunch of musicians that quite a few of them became famous. Those that I had not know except Bobby Starke were Russell Procope, Elmer Williams(alto and tenor), Jonny Hodges, alto, Cuffee…

When Chick found out who I was he told me that he had heard about me and some day he was going to have me in his band. I was to hear this statement from Chick many times and would have been very happy if it had ever come true. Chick had then and after a band that any jazz musician would have been happy to be a member of.
